recognize_zh: 淋巴結低倍下正常濾泡與竇結構完全消失，被瀰漫單調的淋巴樣細胞取代，浸潤延伸至被膜；此倍率只能看出結構破壞，ATLL 的診斷需高倍細胞學、免疫表型與 HTLV-1 檢測。
features: Complete effacement of nodal architecture by a diffuse lymphoid infiltrate
No residual follicles or open sinuses identified
Monotonous cellular infiltrate with scattered vessels
Infiltrate abuts and focally involves the capsule
Cytologic detail not assessable at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of the normal architecture by a sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate, with no residual follicles or patent sinuses. The infiltrate extends up to the capsule. Cytologic features cannot be assessed at this magnification. The pattern indicates a diffuse lymphoma; combined with high-power morphology, a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity, findings are consistent with nodal adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTCL-NOS has a similar diffuse pattern and is distinguished by absence of HTLV-1 infection.
DLBCL also effaces the node but consists of large B cells expressing CD20/PAX5.
Reactive nodes preserve follicles, sinuses and a polymorphous paracortex.
